rotate_device: Please rotate the device to landscape.
instruction: “Look at the picture in a relaxed way. You may follow it with your eyes. Keep your head still.”
asymmetry_and_gain_of_the_optokinetic: Asymmetry and gain of the optokinetic reflex, compared only with the person’s own earlier measurements
please_set_up_the_device_first: Please set up the device first (distance and device type). This is only needed once.
please_use_pseudonyms_only_all_data: Please use pseudonyms only. All data stay on this device.
choose_the_person_read_out_the: Choose the person, read out the instruction, “Start measurement”.
setup_check_as_soon_as_everything: Setup check: as soon as everything is green, calibration starts automatically.
calibration_follow_the_rabbit_with_the: Calibration: follow the rabbit with the eyes.
measurement_alternating_3_times_each_at: Measurement: ← → alternating, 3 times each at 2 speeds (optionally also ↑ ↓). Tap to pause.
result_asymmetry_and_gain_history_for: Result: asymmetry and gain, history for the person.
safari_may_delete_website_data_after: The browser may delete website data after a long period of non-use. Please export regularly.
done_once_by_the_therapist_measurements: Only needed once during setup. Measurements are always taken with the device in landscape in a stand.
measure_the_distance_with_a_ruler: Measure the distance with a ruler or tape measure and keep it the same for every measurement.
please_set_up_device_overview: Please set up the device first (overview).
please_read_out_word_for_word: Please read out word for word
note_measurements_with_different_conditi: Note: measurements with different conditions are not comparable with earlier ones and appear separately in the history.
no_camera_access_please_allow_the: No camera access. Please allow the camera under Settings → Safari → Camera and reload the page.
follow_the_rabbit_with_your_eyes: Follow the rabbit with your eyes. Keep your head still.
the_measurement_starts_in_a_moment: The measurement starts in a moment.
measurement_ended_no_round_completed_not: Measurement ended, no round completed. Nothing saved.
saving_in_the_browser_failed_please: Saving in the browser failed. Please export immediately.
too_few_valid_rounds_for_a: Too few valid rounds for a statement. Please repeat the measurement.
this_is_the_baseline_measurement_what: This is the baseline measurement. What matters is the change in later measurements.
saved_on_this_device_to_back: Saved on this device. To back it up, tap “Export”.
really_delete_this_measurement_exported_: Really delete this measurement? Exported files are kept.
how_fast_the_eyes_follow_the: How fast the eyes follow the pattern (1.0 = equally fast). Only comparable with the person’s own measurements under the same conditions.
automatically_repeated_round_asymmetry_p: * automatically repeated round. Asymmetry per round: (right − left) ÷ mean; measurement fluctuation = 95 % confidence interval from the repetitions.
measurement_from_version_1_of_the: Measurement from version 1 of the app (different procedure). Not comparable with quick-check measurements.
device_storage_not_available_private_win: Device storage not available (private window?). Export measurements immediately.
setup_hint: Device in landscape in a stand, camera at eye level, light from the front, distance {cm} cm.
camera_start_failed: Camera or face detection could not start ({error}).
auto_start_in: All set – calibration starts in {s} s
paused_info: Round {i} of {n}. The interrupted round restarts when you resume.
rl_clear_title_right: Direction difference: followed less to the right
rl_clear_title_left: Direction difference: followed less to the left
rl_clear_body_right: {v}, larger than the measurement fluctuation ({ci}): the eyes followed patterns moving right less than patterns moving left. This is an observation, not an assessment. Lighting, head position, distance and the device can influence such differences. What matters is the change in later measurements.
rl_clear_body_left: {v}, larger than the measurement fluctuation ({ci}): the eyes followed patterns moving left less than patterns moving right. This is an observation, not an assessment. Lighting, head position, distance and the device can influence such differences. What matters is the change in later measurements.
rl_small_body: {v} (measurement fluctuation {ci}). The app does not show differences below {min} % as a direction difference.
rl_unclear_body: {v}, but the measurement fluctuation of {ci} is too large for a reliable statement. Please repeat the measurement.
ud_body_up: Up stronger (measurement fluctuation {ci}). An upward advantage is common, and vertical differences vary between individuals. What matters is the change compared with the person’s own earlier measurements.
ud_body_down: Down stronger (measurement fluctuation {ci}). An upward advantage is common, and vertical differences vary between individuals. What matters is the change compared with the person’s own earlier measurements.
calib_issue_weak: The eyes were detected too rarely at {n} of {total} points. Add more light, keep the face centred, remove reflective glasses if needed.
calib_issue_horizontal: Left/right eye movement was not detected cleanly. Follow the target with your eyes only; do not turn your head.
calib_issue_vertical: Up/down eye movement was not detected cleanly. Open the eyes wide enough, light from the front, keep the head straight.
calib_issue_center: The centre point was not looked at consistently. Please fixate each target steadily.
calib_issue_head: The head moved during calibration. Please keep the head still or support it.
calib_issue_head_hand: The device moved too much during calibration. Please hold it more steadily and support the elbows.
not_a_medical_device: Wellness app, not a medical device. It is not intended to detect, monitor or treat any disease and does not replace a medical examination.
card_instructions: Place a card in the standard bank-card format (e.g. bank card, loyalty card, library card or driving licence) flat on the screen, exactly at the marked corner of the frame. Then use − and + or the slider to change the frame size until the frame and the card are exactly the same size.
card_check: Do not zoom in with two fingers while doing this. Repeat the match after changing the display size in the device settings.
card_zoom_warning: The view is zoomed in. Please pinch back to normal size, otherwise the match will be wrong.
no_camera_access_android: No camera access. Please allow the camera: in Chrome via the icon to the left of the address → Permissions, in the installed app via App info → Permissions. Then reload the page.
no_camera_access_other: No camera access. Please allow the camera for this page in the browser and reload the page.
install_hint_android: Tip: choose “Install app” in the Chrome menu ⋮. The app then gets its own icon and runs full screen.
install_hint_ios: Tip: in Safari, tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”. The app then gets its own icon and runs full screen.
card_privacy: Only the size is compared. The camera is off, the card is neither read nor photographed, and nothing is entered.
card_start: Set the screen size with a card
card_short: Place the card at the marked corner and adjust the size until frame and card are the same size.
card_not_set: Not set yet. Please set the screen size with a card first.
